   • CVR: 2.0% → 1.72% (-14%, down (drag))
   • AOV: 2,054 → 1,783 EGP (-13%, down (drag))

   *Read:* *CVR* fell -14%, the biggest of the three.
     Worth about *-22,670 EGP of revenue at the same clicks*.
     That drove ROAS -13%.
     Revenue -31% because spend -20%.
